items.title: Brock Bowers: Trending in wrong direction
items.text:
Adam Schefter of ESPN reported on Sunday NFL Countdown that "there is not a lot of optimism" that Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) will suit up Sunday at Denver, but the tight end is "pushing to play."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: Out at least six weeks, per Rapoport
items.text:
Maye, who reportedly suffered a fractured right fibula last Sunday, is on track to miss at least six weeks, according to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Davante Adams: 'Outside chance' to play Week 13
items.text:
Adams (hamstring) has an "outside chance" to return from injured reserve for the Rams' Week 13 matchup with the Chiefs but is more likely to be activated around mid-December, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Could take time regarding next destination
items.text:
Assuming Jones clears waivers,  NFL Insiders Adam Schefter and 
Ian Rapoport indicate that the QB is unlikely to sign with a new team immediately, instead preferring to "wait for the right opportunity with the right team at the right time."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alec Pierce: Expected to be shut down for season
items.text:
Pierce's season "is almost certainly over" due to the heel injury that landed the wideout on IR on Sept. 26, according to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
